summary: AFK exhausted the bounded deterministic-qa repair capacity with unresolved blocker(s) QA-01.

findingLineage.summary: The cleaner dispatch journals phase-started but never phase-ended, so no stage-duration sample is ever derived for agent "cleaner" and every round leaves a permanently open stage.
findingLineage.evidence: src/orchestrator.ts:6836-6847 emits the only cleaner journal event: logger.phase(..., { type: "phase-started", ghIssue: slice.ghIssue, sliceNumber: slice.number, agent: "cleaner", round }). Searching the whole source tree for `agent: "cleaner"` returns exactly that one hit; every other role (planner, evaluator-contract, explorer, generator, evaluator-qa, evaluator-uat) emits a matching phase-ended. RunJournal.observeStageDuration (src/run-journal.ts:133-169) stores the start in `openStages` on phase-started and returns immediately for any payload whose type is not "phase-ended", so stage-duration is only appended when a phase-ended pairs with the open start under stageInvocationKey({ghIssue, agent, round}) (src/stage-durations.ts:1-90). A QA probe (temporary edit to this worktree only, discarded with it) read events.jsonl at the end of the spawned scenario "a clean policy reverts a regression and exhausts its rounds" in src/qa-orchestration.test.ts and printed every event whose agent === "cleaner": `PROBE cleaner events: ["phase-started","phase-started","phase-started"]` — three cleaner rounds, three starts, zero ends, therefore zero stage-duration events. Secondarily, the payload's `round` is the enclosing generator round rather than cleanerInput.round, so all three cleaner rounds collide on one stageInvocationKey and "last start wins" (src/run-journal.ts:137-138) discards the earlier two; even with a phase-ended added under that key at most one of the three rounds could ever produce a duration. No test observes this: src/cleaner-stage.test.ts stubs the dispatch seam and so cannot see journaling at all, and no phase-ended or stage-duration assertion anywhere in src/ mentions the cleaner.
findingLineage.clearCondition: After a run in which the cleaner stage executes N rounds, the run journal contains, for agent "cleaner", N phase-started events and N matching phase-ended events that pair under distinct stageInvocationKeys (one per cleaner round, not per generator round), yielding N stage-duration events; RunJournal leaves no cleaner stage open at the end of the stage; and a test observing the journal of a spawned or dispatch-level cleaner run asserts those events and would fail if either the start, the end, or the per-round key distinction were removed.
